curly.title: Curly Method
curly.desc: It is not just about styling, but about healing the curl from its origin. We recover the elasticity and natural memory of your hair through the use of pure minerals and micronized plants that nourish the fiber without adding weight.
curly.imgAlt: Curly Method: Recovery of natural curl

alisado.title: Amino-Protein Straightening
alisado.desc: A revolution in organic straightening that disciplines hair while protecting it. Our formula rich in amino acids rebuilds the internal structure, leaving a smooth, moving mane with an unmatched three-dimensional shine.
alisado.rec1: Post-treatment is included. It is essential to continue a Secretos del Agua care routine at home to guarantee results.
alisado.rec2: During the first days, keep hair loose, without tight ponytails or braids.
alisado.rec3: Blow-dry completely with hands and dryer directing the straightening. Heat activates keratin like a protective wax.
alisado.rec4: If you let it air dry, you will obtain a more wavy and natural result.
